question.en: Discuss the role of the World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) in promoting sustainable tourism in developing economies.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) in promoting sustainable tourism in developing economies.

modelAnswer.en: The UNWTO plays a critical role by providing policy frameworks, technical assistance, and data-driven insights. It emphasizes the 'Global Code of Ethics for Tourism' to ensure that tourism growth does not compromise environmental or cultural integrity, thereby fostering inclusive economic development.
